basic_info.headline: Software Engineer at IGT
basic_info.about:
I'm a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience working primarily in C# and Unity. 

I'm currently working for IGT(International Game Technologies) who deals with making slot machine games.  During my time there, I've closely collaborated with teams comprised of artists, sound engineers, project managers, technical artists, mathematicians, game designers, and more to create amazing Slot Machine games. Additionally, I deal with converting Domestic games to be applicable for different Jurisdictions such as New York and Washington which tends to be individual work as opposed to team work. While those are my main tasks of the job, I've also aided in training other engineers and am constantly developing tools that have drastically improved development times of games and will continue to do so. 

Two of the things I have grown most fond of since working at IGT is working in a team and being able to take on progressively more difficult tasks. While I work fine alone, the vast resources a team can provide makes it an absolutely fantastic experience. You get to see the different ideas everyone has and can merge the best of all of them into something much better than one person would come up with.  Additionally, being able to take an more difficult tasks has been a very rewarding experience. I have found it quite invigorating and intend on putting myself in a position that lends itself to working on more difficult projects. 

I currently have a Bachelors of Science in Computer Science and Engineering from the University of Nevada, Reno. 

I'm always open to hearing from others, be it former colleagues or even just people interested in getting to know more, so feel free to connect with me.

projects.name: MIDI Music Genre Classification
projects.description: Implemented a committee of neural networks capable of classifying MIDI files between 10 genres with a 93% accuracy. The project utilized the Torch framework.

projects.name: Cloud Based Online Social Network Project (Python)
projects.description: Initial progression of the project involved creating a client-to-server model in which clients registered to a server via UDP, and used that server to establish a TCP connection to another client. Later, that model was changed to a peer-to-peer model, with the client using a cloud provider to store information. Tasks involved were using the Google Drive API to manage the cloud storage, establishing file transfer through TCP and HTTP, establishing multiple concurrent chat sessions, keeping a database of friends and their content, and testing against other student’s client programs.
